verdict.summary: Creating an app and connecting your own organisation is self-serve and free, but the free Starter tier stops at 5 connections. Going beyond that needs a paid tier (from AUD 35/month), which Xero lists as requiring App Certification. Apps created since 2026-03-02 also only get granular scopes, and third parties report that Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Journals reads are restricted to approved partners or higher tiers, which bites finance agents.

evidence.label: inferred
evidence.note: Create a web app (or PKCE app) in My Apps, set a redirect URI, and connect your own or the Demo Company organisation. Starter is free for up to 5 connections.

timeToProd.assumes: An app that connects more than 5 customer organisations (Core tier or above) and reads/writes invoices and contacts, so it needs App Certification; up to 5 connections works the same day on Starter.
timeToProd.waitingOn: Xero App Certification review for Core and above, plus a security assessment and use-case approval if you need Journals (Advanced tier).

evidence.label: inferred
evidence.note: Xero's FAQ ties certification to Core and above but gives no certification timeline. The range is our estimate.

verdict.cost: Starter free (5 connections). Core AUD 35/month (50 connections, 10 GB egress), Plus AUD 245 (1,000), Advanced AUD 1,445 (10,000), Enterprise on application. Egress overage AUD 2.40/GB. Prices exclude tax.

prerequisites.item: A Xero account (a free trial or the Demo Company works for testing)
prerequisites.why: Apps are created in the developer portal under your Xero login, and a test organisation is needed to authorize.

prerequisites.item: A payment method once you pass 5 connections
prerequisites.why: Connecting a 6th organisation needs payment details and moves the app to the Core tier.

prerequisites.item: A plan that meets the certification checkpoints
prerequisites.why: Xero's FAQ lists App Certification for the Core, Plus, Advanced and Enterprise tiers.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: We couldn't read the certification checkpoints page itself (client-rendered).

prerequisites.item: A data-use policy that excludes AI/ML training on Xero data
prerequisites.why: Xero's updated terms prohibit using data from its APIs to train or contribute to creating AI/ML models.

scopeTiers.impact: Enough for an agent that reads and creates invoices, payments and contacts. New apps can't request the broad accounting.transactions scope. Past 5 connections the tier, rather than the scope, triggers certification.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: offline_access is the standard Xero scope for refresh tokens, but we couldn't confirm it on a readable Xero page.

scopeTiers.impact: Aged debtors/creditors reports work for all new apps.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: Only the aged reports are explicitly confirmed as open to all new apps. Trial balance and bank summary availability is our reading.

scopeTiers.impact: Reported as blocked for standard apps created after 2026-03-02 unless enrolled in Xero's App Partner Program. An FP&A or bookkeeping agent probably needs these.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: From an integration vendor's help article. Another vendor article didn't mention this restriction.

scopeTiers.tier: Premium: Journals, Practice Manager, bulk connections
scopeTiers.impact: Advanced tier (AUD 1,445/month) or higher, plus an initial and annual security assessment and use-case approval.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: Scope strings are illustrative. The gating is by endpoint and tier per Xero's FAQ.

steps.title: Create the app in My Apps
steps.detail: Sign in at developer.xero.com, open My Apps, and create a Web app (confidential, client secret) or a PKCE app (public clients). Add the HTTPS redirect URI.

evidence.label: tested
evidence.note: https://developer.xero.com/app/manage returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-20. We did not sign in.

steps.title: Implement OAuth with granular scopes and offline_access
steps.detail: Use authorize https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize and token https://identity.xero.com/connect/token (PKCE S256 supported). Request least-privilege granular scopes plus offline_access. After the token exchange, call the connections endpoint to get tenant IDs and send xero-tenant-id on each call.

evidence.label: tested
evidence.note: Endpoints and PKCE support were read from the live discovery document. Connections/tenant handling is standard Xero practice we couldn't re-read on the client-rendered docs.

steps.title: Build rotation-safe token storage
steps.detail: Access tokens last 30 minutes. Each refresh returns a new refresh token and invalidates the old one, and unused refresh tokens lapse after about 60 days. Serialize refreshes per connection and run a keep-alive refresh for idle tenants.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: Lifetimes come from a third-party guide. Xero's limits page couldn't be read.

steps.title: Connect a test organisation and verify
steps.detail: Authorize your own org or the Demo Company. Check the X-MinLimit-Remaining and X-DayLimit-Remaining headers on responses.

steps.title: Model connections and egress to pick a tier
steps.detail: Estimate customer orgs and monthly GET payload volume (egress excludes the Organisation endpoint). Map them to Starter (5), Core (50), Plus (1,000) or Advanced (10,000).

steps.title: Prepare for certification checkpoints
steps.detail: Review the certification checkpoints (connection flow, scopes, error handling, branding) and draft evidence, screenshots and a privacy policy that states Xero data isn't used for AI/ML training.

evidence.label: inferred
evidence.note: The checkpoint list itself couldn't be read (client-rendered).

steps.title: Add payment details and request certification
steps.detail: Add a payment method in the developer portal to move beyond Starter, and submit the app for certification.

steps.title: Wait for certification
steps.detail: Xero reviews the app against the checkpoints. Use-case approval and security assessment for premium endpoints follow a separate path through support.

evidence.label: inferred
evidence.note: No timeline was published on the pages we read.

steps.title: Apply for App Partner Program / premium access if needed
steps.detail: If the agent needs P&L, Balance Sheet or Journals, apply for App Partner enrolment and the Advanced tier, and complete the security assessment.

agentCanDo: Choose minimal granular scopes and migrate off accounting.transactions
Estimate connections and egress to recommend a pricing tier
Draft certification evidence and an AI-training-free data policy
Prototype with Xero's hosted Remote MCP or CLI
humanMustDo: Create the app in My Apps under a Xero login
Add payment details once you pass 5 connections
Submit for certification and any App Partner Program enrolment
Complete the security assessment for premium endpoints

blockers.symptom: A 6th customer can't connect, or the portal asks for payment details
blockers.cause: The Starter tier is capped at 5 connections.
blockers.fix: Add a payment method to move to Core (AUD 35/month, 50 connections) and complete certification.

blockers.cause: Apps created on or after 2026-03-02 can't use the broad accounting.transactions or accounting.reports.read scopes.
blockers.fix: Request granular scopes (accounting.invoices, accounting.payments, accounting.banktransactions and so on) and have existing users reauthorize.

blockers.symptom: Profit & Loss or Balance Sheet report calls are refused for a new app
blockers.cause: Reported restriction of these reports to App Partner Program members for apps created after 2026-03-02.
blockers.fix: Enrol in the App Partner Program, or derive figures from invoices, bank transactions and the trial balance.

evidence.label: unverified
evidence.note: From a vendor help article. The exact error wasn't given.

blockers.cause: More than 60 calls/min, 5,000/day or 5 concurrent calls per tenant, or 10,000/min across the app.
blockers.fix: Honour Retry-After, track the X-*Limit-Remaining headers, and use webhooks or If-Modified-Since rather than polling.

blockers.cause: A rotated refresh token was reused (race), or the connection sat idle past the refresh-token lifetime.
blockers.fix: Lock refreshes per connection, persist each new refresh token, and refresh idle connections periodically. Otherwise send the user to reconnect.

nuances.text: Xero's terms prohibit using API data to train or contribute to creating AI/ML models. Inference-time use in an agent isn't the same as training, but keep Xero data out of fine-tuning and eval datasets.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: The training-vs-inference distinction is our reading.

nuances.text: Pricing is by connections plus egress (GET payload volume, measured in GiB, excluding the Organisation endpoint). Ingress is unlimited. A chatty read-heavy agent can run up overage at AUD 2.40/GB.
Rate limits apply per connection (tenant): 60/min, 5,000/day, 5 concurrent, plus 10,000/min app-wide. One third-party guide claims Starter apps get only 1,000 calls/day.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: The Starter 1,000/day figure is unverified (third-party, and the same article misstates Advanced pricing).

nuances.text: Existing tokens don't silently gain granular scopes. Each connected user has to reauthorize, and older apps have until September 2027 to migrate.

Xero's Remote MCP server went GA in October 2026 with 39 tools (invoices, contacts, P&L, balance sheet and more). Setup uses your own PKCE app's client ID, so the same tier and connection rules apply.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: Whether MCP report tools bypass the reported P&L restriction for new apps is not stated.

nuances.text: Multi-organisation users authorize several tenants in one consent. Every API call needs the xero-tenant-id header for the target org, and each tenant counts as a connection toward the tier cap.
